Eri: Good work, you two.
Bullet: Not at all...
Kusuha: So, how did the T-Link test turn out?
Robert: Unfortunately, we didn't get any notable reaction.
Sophia: So the reaction we picked up while monitoring the T-Link systems the other day really was just noise.
Kusuha: Then RyuOhKi and KoOhKi have gone into a long dormancy...?
Eri: Since they won't answer you, their former pilots, that seems very likely.
Bullet: Will they never wake up again?
Robert: We'd rather ask you that. You're the only ones here who can talk to RyuOhKi and KoOhKi.
Bullet: I'm sorry we couldn't be more help...
Robert: Ah, no... It's not your fault.
Eri: I'm sorry for calling you to Tesla Reich in such a rush. I'm afraid it may have been a wasted trip.
Kusuha: Not at all.
Robert: My share of the ART-1 tuning is done for now, and I had business here anyway, so it worked out for me.
Bullet: Art One?
Robert: The prototype for the next-generation R Series we're building at Izu.
Bullet: You're already building something like that...
Robert: The <SRX Project> doesn't end just because we built the SRX.
Robert: We've been designing it for ages, and it's almost assembled. It won't be in the Aviano trials, though.
Eri: ...Lieutenant Brooklyn, Lieutenant Kusuha. May we continue our research on the Chokijin?
Bullet: Yes, please do.
Kusuha: We're worried about them, too.
Eri: Understood.
Sophia: Anyway, that's all we need from you. We requested you for three days, so you have two to spare.
Sophia: We may run some follow-up tests, but take it easy.
Robert: Kamchatka must've been cold, huh? Bet you couldn't even go on a proper date.
Bullet: N-No, sir.
Robert: How's work going?

Kusuha: Is everyone on the Hagane busy?

Kusuha: R-Really...?

Robert: Come on, just go out and grab a bite to eat.
Bullet: But...
Robert: Relax while you can. OK?
Bullet: R-Roger. ...Let's go, Kusuha.

Robert: (S-So I don't get a break...)
Tesla Reich Institute
Bullet: Huh? Ibis and the others are away on assignment?
Kusuha: Yeah. Apparently the Astelion got damaged on their last mission...
Bullet: Mission?
Kusuha: Disposing of an <Inspectors>... unmanned combat satellite.
Bullet: (An Inspector combat satellite... There were still some of those left?)
Kusuha: Ibis completed the mission, but the Astelion was damaged...
Kusuha: So they modified it... and now it's apparently in test flights.
Bullet: I see... Ibis and the others are working hard too.
Kusuha: ...
Kusuha: Hey, Bullet. Do you think RyuOhKi and KoOhKi went to sleep... because of us?
Bullet: What makes you think that?
Kusuha: Because we're... no, because I'm not strong enough... Maybe RyuOhKi doesn't need me anymore...
Bullet: That's not true. They fought alongside us to the very end in the Inspector Incident.
Kusuha: (But... maybe...)
Bullet: There must be another reason KoOhKi and RyuOhKi went to sleep. Let's wait for Dr. Anzai's team's results.
Kusuha: ...
Bullet: Anyway, let's head into the nearby town today.
Bullet: We came all this way, so let's eat something we can't get in Petropavlovsk before we go back.
Kusuha: ...Okay. We need to buy souvenirs for Lieutenant Kyosuke and Lieutenant Excellen, too.
Bullet: Right. Booze will do for Lieutenant Excellen... but what should we get Lieutenant Kyosuke?
Rishu: Ah, Bullet. So this is where you were.
Bullet: Sensei!
Rishu: Well? Made any progress?
Bullet: I've kept up my training, but I haven't been crossing swords with anyone, so...
Rishu: No, not that.
Bullet: Then you mean the Super Robot?
Rishu: Good grief. Having such a blockhead for a partner must be hard on you, eh, Kusuha?
Kusuha: Oh... no, not at all.
Rishu: ...Sorry to interrupt your rendezvous, but you two have been summoned. Head to the control room.
Kusuha: Yes, sir.
Tesla Reich Institute - Control Room
Bullet: Kusuha and I are going to Aviano?
Kyosuke: Right. You know the next-generation mainstay unit trials are being held there?
Bullet: Yes. They're choosing the successor to the Mass Production Hückebein, right?
Kyosuke: The man in charge of those trials... Brigadier General Mauro Gatt, sent a request.
Kyosuke: He wants the two of you to join the evaluation tests in the Grungust Type 3.
Bullet: So he asked for us by name.
Kyosuke: Yes. Your ETA on site is 1100, five days from now.

Excellen: Whoa, you actually looked? Aren't you the diligent one.

Bullet: Understood.
Kyosuke: That's all. I'm counting on you, Bullet, Kusuha.
Excellen: ...Mmhmm. If you keep it hush-hush, stretching the trip by a day is A-OK. Bye now!

Kusuha: Heh, true.
Jonathan: Even so... so you two are headed to Aviano as well.

Jonathan: Yes, Ibis's team was named too. After the Astelion's standard cruise test, they'll go to Aviano.
Kusuha: Then we can all go there together.
Jonathan: Right. For now, just relax here until the date. We'll do maintenance on the Type-3 meanwhile.
Bullet: Thank you. ...By the way, Director, how many unit types are being entered in the trial?
Jonathan: Four, from what I hear. But there's almost no information out on one of them.
Jonathan: We do know the developer is Wong Heavy Industries, part of the Isurugi group, but...
Bullet: (Wong Heavy Industries...)

Rai: The Leios Plan?
Ryusei: What's that?
Viletta: ReEOTH... Simply put, it's a plan to improve the reliability of the <EOT> used in the SRX Project.
Rai: I see... A measure with an eye to the future, then.
Viletta: Yes.
Ryusei: So is it connected to the "RXR Project" Rob and the others are doing... developing the ART-1?

Viletta: The ART-1 is also a unit for exploring that direction.

Ryusei: Don't make it sound like the underworld or something.
Aya: As her big sister, I want Mai to take an interest in things like clothes and accessories too.

Aya: Um, Captain?

Aya: Get Ling's permission first, please.
Irm: Ugh...

Rai: ...You were saying something about prototypes in robot anime.
Ryusei: Right, right. In robot anime, it's a rule that the prototype is always stronger.
Ryoto: Not every single time, though.
Aya: R-Ryoto... You too?
Ryoto: Huh? W-well, I... It's Dr. Omiya's influence.
Aya: (Maybe I should watch them too... these robot anime.)
Mai: ...So being a prototype has nothing to do with strength...

Rai: As a one-off packed with every new technology imaginable, regardless of cost, its power is tremendous.
Rai: But a weapon's true strength lies in reliability: efficient maintenance, uptime, stable output, and so on.
Ryoto: From that standpoint, the SRX still has a lot of room for improvement.
Mai: So that's what the Leios Plan is for.

Mai: Understood, Aya.

Mai: Yeah.
Aya: (I'm worried... I'm really worried...)

Ryusei: Yeah. Patrols, hunting down Neue DC remnants, VIP transport, transport escort...
Ryusei: Plus base festivals and photo shoots... We're seriously busy.

Ryusei: Oh, right.
Rai: She's probably over there in connection with that.
Ryusei: I see. Heh... Maybe she'll tell me something about the trial machines.
Ryoto: I doubt it. Info on new models is classified as a rule.
Ryusei: Yeah... They wouldn't even show us the cargo on that transport escort mission the other day.
Rio: Come on, hurry to the comm room. Latune's waiting.
